title: tableCOMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Table COMP instances, covering cell ID conversion helpers, simulated table cell clicks, keyboard focus, and inherited PanelCOMP / COMP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when a script needs to convert between a Table COMP cell ID and row or column coordinates, including IDs from panel values such as celloverid or cellfocusid.
Use click(row, col) for row and column addressing, or clickID(id) when the workflow already has a cell ID.
The click helpers use the left mouse button by default when left, middle, and right are all false.
Use force carefully because it can force a table cell click even when the panel is disabled.
Use setKeyboardFocus(row, col, selectAll=True) only when the target cell is an editable field and the script should select its contents.
